conditions: Use only the exact 5-minute walk, ten 1-minute run/1-minute walk bouts, 5-minute walk protocol and supported nonconsecutive schedule; no automatic later GRONORUN progression.
Current walking context, ability to use conversational cues and ordinary nonclinical V1 eligibility must be explicit. A materially different population/context requires a new scope review.
Observe initial actual execution, symptoms, effort and function before progressing; no simultaneous inferred strength increase.
Every named configuration and eight-repetition easy/moderate load must be currently demonstrated and concretely bound; no equipment-name or other-modality competence transfer.
Only one set of eight on the four listed machines, with the finite supported schedule and unchanged established loads; no claim that this is optimal or a full effective chronic program.
Unknown movement competence, current load or equipment configuration routes ASK; response/technique precedes progression.

Episodes must demonstrate all three sets completed with uniform actual repetitions at the exact current configuration/load, acceptable technique and familiar effort target; no aggregate-repetition inference.
Keep load, rest, configuration, other adequate sessions and current chosen week unchanged; select only 3x9 from the listed 3x8 plan.
Repeated observations are case premises, not a validated universal minimum count or permission for an unbounded progression loop; RIR remains an imprecise familiar task anchor.
Local nonclinical calf concern, named optional unperformed component, concrete unchanged squat load and compatible essential execution must all be established.

Prefer the familiar one-set calf candidate when sufficient; omit both listed sets only when one set is explicitly still inadequate. No completed-history rewrite, essential removal, later compensation or whole-week replan.
Pain, functional limitation, systemic uncertainty or degraded essentials invalidate this branch and require the appropriate HOLD/clinical handling.

Current material necessity, compatible easy work and exact authorized familiar Thursday/Saturday branch/window must be supplied; optional-only reduction must be insufficient. Overlap or a wearable warning alone is insufficient.
Preserve dose and essential session intent; move only the named prospective sessions and preserve other commitments.
The later hard session remains conditional on a fresh readiness/context check; this record supplies no universal recovery interval or chronic interference diagnosis.
Current exact load/configuration, repeated comparable under-target pattern, acceptable first two sets and actual prior tolerance of 2x8 must be explicit.

Remove only the defined third set for the next exposure, preserving load, rest and familiar effort anchor. Essential intent must remain admissible and a smaller supported rest change must be insufficient. Do not iterate decrements or reinterpret unknown recording as failure.
Do not claim two sets are physiologically equivalent to three or sufficient for every hypertrophy/strength goal; reassess goal adequacy and response.
The exact target pace, recovery, configuration and four-bout prior tolerance must be supplied; comparable fifth-bout degradation and current necessity are required.

Choose only 4x3 minutes at the unchanged established target/recovery after essential-intent admissibility and insufficiency of a smaller supported rest change. No extra fast running, compensation, density increase or new family.
Target-method/construct mismatch, materially changed conditions, missing calibration or incompatible response invalidates the choice.
Exact current comparable 45-minute easy exposure and compatible response are required; generic toleranceKnown or remote history cannot establish this bound.
Use only the finite 40-to-45-minute option with the same practical easy intent and unchanged other dose dimensions, respecting current week adequacy.
Do not chain incremental increases, infer injury prevention from a small percentage, or equate duration tolerance across terrain/pace/other-modality load changes.
Reason must be explicitly nonclinical, prior task familiar, current 20-minute execution/response established, and proposed schedule compatible with current context.
Use only the current established easy recipe and bounded schedule; no claim of restored prior capacity, automatic weekly dose escalation or percentage of historical plan.
Unknown current capacity routes ASK/establishment; injury/illness/persistent pain/clearance-dependent return remains clinical.
Document nonclinical interruption and current demonstrated configuration, technique and concrete loads for every proposed machine.
Use only the one-set eight-repetition familiarization recipe/schedule at current bound loads; no historical-load restoration or guaranteed retention claim.
Missing current evidence routes ASK; clinical-dependent return, changed equipment or incompatible current response invalidates approval.
Keep executable HOLD/NOT_SUPPORTED_YET for this combined week until a complete matched joint-horizon comparator and admissibility review exist.
Do not import endurance percentages, claim strength maintenance, introduce strides/race-pace work by label or treat confirmation as scientific approval.
Keep executable HOLD/NOT_SUPPORTED_YET until a complete familiar baseline, combined candidate doses/ordering and race-proximity rationale are reviewed.
No generic taper percentage, assumed strength maintenance or clinical post-event prescription is approved.
Retain the Balanced preference and explicit temporary choice; keep the unreviewed combined week unsupported.
A future review must justify the whole joint horizon; preference alone cannot establish a dose or priority inversion.
Require exact selected recipe toleranceFactId/toleratedRecipeId and compatible current exposure, complete associated facts, target method and construct; a bare tolerance boolean is insufficient.
Easy/long practical talk cues do not identify LT2/CS. Familiar cruise/VO2-style/strides targets remain task anchors; pace, HR, power and laboratory constructs are not interchangeable.
Keep already concrete adequate prescriptions; missing hard-family calibration routes ASK/NOT_SUPPORTED_YET, and any easy fallback itself requires exact familiar tolerance.
Necessity and both exact alternatives must already be independently admissible in the joint horizon; purpose/agency and comparable same-athlete source provenance are required.
Reject duplicated/incomplete/noncomparable/noisy history, conflicting direction or changed context. Any sample count is a bounded software witness requirement, not a universal confidence threshold.
Keep population prior and noncausal uncertainty visible; ranking cannot change doses, completed history, priority or expand the candidate set.
